prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering onboarding steps (moving sign-in after adoption) was helpful and exceeded predictions (+16.8% measured vs +12.0% predicted).
Live progress visualizers on the waiting screen were helpful and far exceeded predictions (+9.3% measured vs +2.0% predicted), whereas static time estimates, safeguards, and mascot updates showed no clear effect.
Finish screen additions (control guides, notification prompts, owner badges) showed no clear effect, and predictions were set too high.
Adoption step layout changes and redesigns showed no clear effect, with predictions (up to +15.0%) being overly optimistic.
Path selection copy and layout adjustments showed no clear effect, over-predicting impact.
Sign-in hints and safeguard warnings showed no clear effect, with predictions set too high.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: +2.4% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -2.5% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.6% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -1.0% over 1 test(s)
- finish, incentive: -2.5% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -6.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: -5.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +3.2% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.5% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +16.8% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 83.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.2%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Split Stage Path Options Redesign: Redesign the path selection screen into a spotlight stage layout highlighting pet creation choices cleanly. (why: The choose_path step drops 23.8% of users and has a high mean time of 514s, indicating hesitation during path selection.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Post-Onboarding Desktop Quick Controls Screen: Add a new desktop controls guide screen after home welcome showing how to drag, hide, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: Multiple support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, while finish step conversion drops to 64.8%.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Adoption Multi-Step Flow: Re-architect the adoption pet picker screen using a checklist layout with step counter progress. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate in the main onboarding flow at 60.9% and a long mean completion time of 1017s.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In Screen Before Final Launch: Shift the sign-in step to happen right before home intro after pet adoption generation waiting completes. (why: Moving sign-in after adoption previously increased conversion; placing sign-in right before launch aligns with user expectations after pet creation.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Restore Hint: Add a prominent hint on the sign-in screen reminding returning users to sign into their original account to preserve saved pets. (why: Support received 8 emails from users whose pets were missing or reset after signing in with a different account.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Readiness Checklist: Display a live checklist component on the waiting screen showing desktop initialization status. (why: Home wait step has a mean duration of 2336s and support reported 3 cases where pets failed to show up on the desktop.)
6: [finish, incentive] First Desktop Companion Welcome Incentive: Display a welcome badge component on the finish screen celebrating the arrival of the user's first desktop pet. (why: Finish screen conversion is only 64.8% with mean time exceeding 5800s, showing drop-off right before active desktop pet usage.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Simplified Welcome Story Copy: Streamline the introductory story headline and body text to clearly convey a quick setup time. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of starting users and takes a mean time of 514s.)
8: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Spotlight Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate layout into a focused spotlight design. (why: Adoption drop-off is high (39.1% drop rate) and custom pet visual failures were reported in support.)
9: [home, notification] Desktop App Focus Notification Prompt: Enable desktop notification readiness alert on the waiting screen when pet generation finishes. (why: Home waiting step has a high mean time (2336s) indicating users switch away or minimize the app while waiting.)

scores.note: Path selection redesigns have shown no clear positive effect in historical tests.
Adding new screens or flows at the finish step historically decreases conversion.
Adoption flow redesigns and multi-step changes have consistently underperformed.
Reordering sign-in step after adoption has proven highly effective (+16.8%).
Addresses clear support reports but sign-in hints yield minimal conversion lift (+0.5%).
Live progress visualizers on waiting screens consistently outperform predictions.
Finish screen additions and incentives showed negative relative lift in past tests.
Copy adjustments on the choose_path screen produce negligible historical impact (+0.6%).
Adoption spotlight redesigns previously resulted in negative conversion lift (-2.5%).
Notification prompts have shown negative impact (-5.4%) in past experiments.
